newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jiangling aims for 1.5 billion yuan sales in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Jiangling aims for 1.5 billion yuan sales in 1996.

text.p: Jianling Motors Corp Ltd forecast sales of 1.5 billion yuan for this year, compared with 1.97 billion yuan racked up in 1995, a company spokesman said on Monday.

The spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin that despite the lower sales target, Jiangling aims to report higher net profits for 1996. But he declined to issue a profit forecast for this year.
A series of cost-cutting measures carried out by Jiangling earlier this year started to show effect in the second half, said the official without elaborating.

In its 1996 interim report under Chinese accounting standards, Jiangling posted an audited net earnings of 3.39 million yuan in the first half of 1996, plunging from 14.96 million yuan in the same 1995 period.
Sales reached 938 million yuan against 1.22 billion yuan in the January-June period of 1995.
The firm reported after-tax profits of 7.73 million yuan for full 1995, down by 93 percent from 117.24 million yuan in 1994.
